about: Batch 5: the output changes made on purpose, compared with 151e40c by `bash scripts/golden-check.sh 151e40c [quick|full] --expect tests/golden_expect/batch5.json --items ...`. Each entry accepts the + or - lines (diff of one item, post against pre) its lines_rx search, in items whose name key_rx searches, in scenarios scenario_rx searches; must_see: the change has to show up wherever its scenarios ran.

entries.why: MASK_VERSION 3 -> 5 (c2, c3, c4; Codex round 1: 2, 3, 4): the marker says every approved copy was masked again by version 5
MASK_VERSION 3 -> 5: each approved copy is re-masked and records version 5; the copy is parsed and must be exactly the same apart from that field (Codex round 1, 11: no copy's text may change)
MASK_VERSION 3 -> 5: engine cache entries are re-masked and record version 5
open_by_severity counts the owner's findings only: the bundled pptx template's WT-T008 platform line (info) leaves it

the new platform_notes {count, lines} and the old platform key holding the same plain lines (was: rule, label, title at path); Codex round 1 (9): both come last, after the owner's part (fitted as if they weren't there), so the key that ends the JSON and its closing brackets move

lines_rx: ^[-+]  "(No canaries planted|Roll-call is off|gitleaks not run|pip-audit not run|OSV-Scanner not run|TruffleHog \(which|SkillSpector and husk|OSV-Scanner \(project|gitleaks \(keys|pip-audit \(installed|Grok Bot settings\.json not found)[^"]*",?$
^[-+]   "title": "(Not scanned: 3 folders|A new file appeared in Grok Bot's own skill folder)[^"]*",$
^[-+]   "fix": "(No action\. Only skills the platform loads|Nothing shows Grok Bot made this change)[^"]*",$
entries.why: Codex round 1 (9): fit() keeps the owner's part of the audit JSON under 4 KB as if there were no platform notes, which then take only their own budget after it; 151e40c's old platform list (one line a note) was inside the 4 KB, so in these two boxes, at the edge on 151e40c, list items 151e40c trimmed can be back (a coverage note; in the platform-refresh box the owner's own WT-I002 high in `new` and `top_fixes`, which 151e40c had cut) and `truncated` counts differ; new_total and delta_file stay whole

lines_rx: ^\+Platform notes \(Grok Bot's own files, not counted\): \d+\. `wt\.py show <rule>` lists them \(WT-[A-Z0-9, -]+\)\.$
entries.why: breakdown's last lines count the platform notes and (Codex round 1, 9 and 10: where the JSON's `more` points) give each one's plain line; they are never in its Confirmed list
